verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair axis for a SaaS billing platform like Chargebee, but the evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or residency. The business-entity header (chargebee-docs-24) is about multi-entity operations, not where data is stored, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
